description: Sodium is a powerful rendering engine for Minecraft which greatly improves frame rates and micro-stutter, while fixing many graphical issues
notes: Client-only renderer. Provides 'indium'. Large breaks list (iris <1.8.13, moreculling <1.0.8, notenoughcrashes <4.4.8, iceberg <1.2.7 - all satisfied).

name: Sophisticated Backpacks
description: Fancy and functional backpacks.
notes: Backpacks holding player items. Needs sophisticatedcore >=1.2.9.15 <1.22. GPL-3 unofficial Fabric port.

name: Sophisticated Core
description: A library / shared functionality mod for Sophisticated Storage and Backpacks
notes: Needed by: sophisticatedbackpacks, sophisticatedstorage. Needs forgeconfigapiport >=21.1.3, team_reborn_energy (nested). Breaks jei <19.21. 12 nested porting_lib jars.

name: Sophisticated Storage
description: Fancy and functional storage containers.
notes: Storage blocks with player items (49 blockstates). Needs sophisticatedcore.

name: Sound Physics Remastered
description: Provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.
notes: Audio (env=*, client effect). Breaks voicechat <2.3.0.

name: SoundsBeGone
description: Allows you to permanently disable specific sounds you don't like. Perfect for people with Misophonia!
notes: Client-only sound muting. Bundles posthog analytics lib (privacy note).

name: SuperMartijn642's Config Lib
description: Config Lib makes dealing with config files just a bit easier.
notes: Needed by: rechiseled (>=1.1.6), obc (>=1.1.8; also nested there). ARR.

name: SuperMartijn642's Core Lib
description: SuperMartijn642's Core Lib adds lots of basic implementations for guis that allow for similar code between Minecraft 1.12, 1.14, 1.15, and 1.16!
notes: Needed by: rechiseled (>=1.1.20 <1.2.0). minecraft >=1.21 <1.21.2. ARR.

name: Tim Core
description: What if my Cobblemon mods worked without a bunch of copy/pasting?
notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon "1.7.3+1.21.1" (exact pin). Needed by: capture_xp. 106 API refs. Both Tim mods must be rebuilt for 1.8 or removed together.

name: TM Craft
description: Cobblemon side mod that adds TMs with crafting recipes
notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon "1.7.3+1.21.1" (exact pin). TMs with crafting recipes + move tutor / breeder table blocks (world-persistent). 31 API refs. GPL-3.0.

name: Tom's Simple Storage Mod
description: Simple storage mod for Minecraft
notes: Storage network blocks holding items (16 blockstates). minecraft >=1.21 <1.21.2. Bundles cardinal-components + cloth-config.

name: ToolTip Fix
description: Fixes ToolTips from running off the screen
notes: Client-only; jar says 1.20 but declares no minecraft dep (loads anywhere). Tiny mixin - low risk.

name: Trinkets
description: Adds a data-driven accessory system to Minecraft
notes: Nothing in the pack hard-depends on trinkets (only recommended by accessories_compat_layer). Candidate for removal unless a resource/data pack or server plugin uses Trinkets slots. minecraft '>1.18' (very loose).

name: VillagerConfig
description: A mod to completely customize villagers.
notes: Villager trade customization (config/VillagerConfig/villagerconfig.json5). If the pack defines custom trades there, becomes gameplay-relevant. No minecraft dep declared. Bundles fiber.

name: Waystones
description: Teleport back to activated waystones. For Survival, Adventure or Servers.
notes: Waystone blocks (45 blockstates) + worldgen placement; player-activated waystones are world state. Needs balm. fabricloader >=0.17.3. ARR.

name: Xaero's Minimap
description: The most vanilla-looking minimap for Minecraft.
notes: Minimap (env=*, has server entrypoint; safe on server). Bundles xaerolib. Breaks xaeroworldmap <1.44.0 (ok).

name: Xaero's World Map
description: A self-writing fullscreen map which also works as an add-on to Xaero's Minimap.
notes: World map. minecraft >1.20.6 <1.21.2. Breaks xaerominimap <26.4.0 (ok).

name: YetAnotherConfigLib
description: YetAnotherConfigLib (yacl) is just that. A builder-based configuration library for Minecraft.
notes: Needed by: zoomify (>=3.6.6); recommended by debugify. fabricloader >=0.17.0.

name: zamega
description: Adds All Megas from Pokemon Legends ZA into Cobblemon! (MSD Required)
notes: Legends Z-A megas: pure data (species_additions, spawn pools, cobblemon assets) - 0 API refs, but hard-depends mega_showdown >=1.6.2+1.7+1.21.1, cobblemon >=1.7, accessories, architectury. Follows MSD's fate. Jar version '1.7.3' = Cobblemon target.

name: Fast Noise
description: Vanilla worldgen optimization mod
notes: Worldgen noise optimization - if it changes noise output the map's future chunks differ; verify determinism vs vanilla before generating. Requires fabricloader >=0.18.4 (highest floor in pack). Breaks moonrise/noisium.

name: Zoomify
description: A zoom mod with infinite customizability.
notes: Client-only zoom. Needs YACL, kotlin >=1.13.8. fabricloader >=0.18.0.
